stem: What is the most likely reason the author includes paragraph 2 in the selection “The Ride of a Lifetime!”?
instruction: Use “The Ride of a Lifetime!” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: To suggest that the Abernathy boys acquired their determination and skills from their father

options.label: B
options.text: To show how much President Theodore Roosevelt meant to all of the members of the Abernathy family

options.label: C
options.text: To explain how Bud and Temple got the idea to ride 2,000 miles on horseback

options.label: D
options.text: To emphasize that good horsemanship was essential to people living in the early 1900s
